verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs describe headcount planning in the same connected model as the budget, and per-new-hire planning via an HRIS connection. That implies planned hires feed the financial forecast. However, role-level granularity and a link to payroll actuals are not explicitly documented, and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: explicit role/position-level planning, documented payroll actuals integration, explicit mechanics of hires flowing into the expense forecast, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can plan headcount at the role level, tied to payroll actuals, with planned hires flowing into the expense forecast

citations.quote: Plan, approve and forecast headcount in the same connected model as your budget, so your financial model stays current as your organization changes.
Understand and plan for each new hire by connecting your HRIS with Abacum
Change an assumption and watch revenue, hiring and cash move together.
